messages.subject: Time recording outstanding — March
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James,

Our records show 6.5 hours of unposted time for the week commencing 23 March. Please could you finalise and post your March time by close of play Friday so we can run the month-end bills. Let me know if you need anything.

Accounts
